risks.title: Competitive pressure in AI infrastructure and CPU markets
risks.quote: The LPX is designed for low latency and high token rate, but its throughput is low. Its model size capacity is low. And its context processing, its ability to absorb a lot of context, for example, for software coding, for agentic workloads, its ability to absorb a great deal of context is lower.
risks.explanation: The quote highlights limitations in NVIDIA's LPX architecture compared to competitors' offerings, signaling potential competitive risk in niche AI inference markets.

risks.title: Export restrictions on AI chips to China
risks.quote: As a result, consistent with last quarter, we are not including any China Data Center compute revenue in our outlook.
risks.explanation: Management explicitly states they are excluding China Data Center compute revenue due to uncertainty around export licenses, directly impacting current revenue visibility.
